title: Global resource scheduler
invariants: all planes share one physical capacity ledger
sum of reserved floors cannot exceed physical capacity
idle reserves are work-conserving and may be borrowed
queued owner demand re-protects its unused reserve
weighted dominant-share fairness breaks equal-priority ties
request identities are content-bound and replay mutation fails closed
preemption only targets eligible lower-priority or borrowed grants
revoking work continues consuming capacity until executor acknowledgement
swarm execution attempts acquire and release global grants
cancelled swarm work cancels pending global admission
dead-letter requeue advances resource identity epoch
implementation state cannot self-grant verification or completion
